preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 3 and 100,000.
Number of edges m is between 0 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: Minimum number of edges t is non-negative.
Number of ways w is non-negative.
Output is a string containing t and w separated by a space.
